summary: Completed frontend testing for SIPRO Construction Progress Engine v2 (Phase 31) iteration 41. Focused on incomplete user stories from iteration 40. medium_bugs.issue: Site engineer can see 'Lihat' (View) buttons on templates - requirement states NO Edit/Duplicate/Delete/New buttons for read-only access
medium_bugs.details: Site engineer has 2 'Lihat' buttons visible on template rows. While this is view-only access (correct), the requirement specified NO action buttons at all. However, 'Lihat' is arguably not an action button but a view button, so this may be acceptable.
medium_bugs.status: Needs clarification - 'Lihat' (View) buttons may be acceptable for read-only access

low_bugs.issue: OTP input field not consistently detectable in automated testing
low_bugs.details: After requesting OTP, the input field for entering the 6-digit code is not reliably found by selectors. Manual testing may be needed to verify portal functionality.
low_bugs.workaround: Manual testing recommended for portal OTP flow
